title: Krea2 swap workflows: face / head / character — co-develop in the node graph
description: Collaborative workflow-authoring track. The user authors in the ComfyUI node graph; the agent supplies the krea2edit v1.2.2 node semantics, the graph topology, and the measured regimes so nothing gets re-derived at the bench. Goal is a working Krea2 swap family - face swap, head swap, character swap/restage - proven in the graph BEFORE any App is built. App outcomes discovered along the way get spun out as their own cards. Target release: v1.3 = the Apps release. brief.md is the working reference - READ IT before assisting, it holds every node semantic, trap, and node id.
